decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed details are considered to be acceptable and the Council is satisfied that condition 4 has been adequately meet.  Although the conditions states that the detailed drawings need to be approved prior to construction, it is considered that if the roof extension is constructed below the ridgeline the purpose of the condition has been meet. 

Therefore as it has been proven that the roof extension is below the ridgeline of the dwelling it is considered that the condition has been complied with.
description: Following approval for erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse - details submitted pursuant to condition 4 (Drawings of proposed roof lights) of approved planning permission 00304/13/P3 dated 25/09/2001.
